name: Value sources
rule: Literal values, field references and expressions are alternative ways to obtain values. Retain their distinct public properties and evaluation contexts. A field reference can identify a writer-inferable dependency; an arbitrary expression does not establish an inverse.
exceptions: Do not replace sizeFromField with an equivalent-looking expression. Fixed sizes remain constraints. Preserve units, scope, exact integer conversion, absence and inheritance for each consuming property.
procedure: Select the declared source form using the owning property family. Do not convert a field reference into HEL text.
Resolve the source in the context and phase listed below. A dependency not yet available is not a numeric zero.
Apply the consuming operation's exact numeric conversion, units, sign and bounds. Reject fractional or overflowing addresses/counts before narrowing.
Apply region limits and checked address arithmetic. Writer inference is a separate dependency-solving operation, not expression evaluation.
rows: Field size: size, sizeFromField, sizeFromExpression
Bytes; evaluated for the field or counted element. Fixed size constrains output.
Counted size is per element. EOF/sentinel regions and encoded extents have separate framing contracts. A local length field may be inferred; an arbitrary expression is not inverted.
Struct size: size, sizeFromField, sizeFromExpression
Bytes from struct start; fixed bound known on entry, dynamic bound applied when available.
Outer bounds remain active. Dynamic unresolved size is not permission to escape the enclosing region.
Count: repeatCount, repeatCountFromField, repeatCountFromExpression
Nonnegative integral element count; zero is meaningful.
Count is not byte extent. Validate before allocation and charge shared work budgets.
Address: atOffset, atOffsetFromField, atOffsetFromExpression
Integral byte displacement relative to the declared origin; then alignment.
Checked origin arithmetic; reject invalid physical addresses. Restore the enclosing cursor after addressed reads/writes as specified.
Dimensions: dimensionSize / dimensionSizeFromField
Positive integral logical cell counts when the layout is materialized.
Physical addressing dimensions are not semantic scientific axes.
Stride: dimensionStride / dimensionStrideFromField / dimensionStrideFromExpression
Positive integral byte stride; evaluated with layout context.
Stride is not cell precision or packed bit width. Missing explicit stride uses the declared layout's calculation, not zero.

name: Ordered selection
rule: Ordered conditional rules select the first applicable rule. This common description does not supply a universal fallback or evaluation phase.
exceptions: Type selection retains dispatchDefault/dataType fallback and its missing-type error. Mapping, cell type, dimension order and byte order retain their own activation, defaults and errors. Keyed dispatch collects uniquely keyed arms across the graph; it is not an ordered predicate list.
procedure: Visit rules in RDF-list order in the family's evaluation context.
Select the first condition that evaluates to Boolean true; later matches do not override it.
Apply the family-specific fallback and error behavior below. Never assume a universal missing-value or exception policy.
rows: Field datatype
Before field decoding; instance and parent alias the containing struct in the engine.
Fallback to the fixed dataType. Evaluation errors propagate through parser error handling.
Struct byte order
Starts with struct order; retry after discriminator fields become available.
First successful match locks order for subsequent fields; unevaluable HEL conditions are nonmatching while reading the discriminator. Explicit field datatype order remains an override.
Layout cell datatype
At layout materialization; independent of dimension ordering.
No matching arm is an error. Fixed and conditional declarations are mutually exclusive.
Layout dimension order
At layout materialization; independent of cell selection.
No matching arm is an error. Keep independent selections rather than duplicating a cross-product of layouts.
Semantic property mapping
After parsing; instance is the owning struct and parent is its real parent.
Selected rule supplies property and value expression together; direct mapsToProperty is the fallback. Evaluation exceptions are not automatically false.
Semantic class mapping
After parsing; current struct, real parent and root are available.
Fallback to mapsToClass. The current engine treats a HEL evaluation exception in a class condition as nonmatching.
Keyed dispatch (separate mechanism)
Select by key across uniquely keyed contributed arms.
Not a first-match predicate list. Retain key equality, duplicate rejection, dispatch default and fixed datatype fallback.

name: Encoding shorthand
rule: isEncodedWith denotes a single unparameterized codec. hasEncodingStep is an ordered pipeline in encoder order; decoding traverses that order in reverse.
exceptions: Preserve mutual exclusion, parameters, codec framing, decoded address space, region bounds and capability rejection. A pipeline description does not imply that every parser or writer supports it.
procedure: Normalize one isEncodedWith codec to a one-element codec sequence.
Normalize hasEncodingStep by reading each codec in list order. The interpreter carries per-stage integer options. Zlib and raw DEFLATE support level=-1 or 0..9; other settings reject explicitly.
Encode in declared order; decode in reverse. Each codec retains its framing, failure and byte-budget contract.
Reject simultaneous forms, malformed/cyclic lists, missing or multiple codecs and empty pipelines. Unknown codec execution fails; no identity fallback is allowed.
rows: isEncodedWith codec
One codec, no supplied parameters
Supported shorthand remains available.
hasEncodingStep ([codec A])
Same one-step sequence
Same parser/writer values and wire bytes for the tested zlib case.
hasEncodingStep ([codec A] [codec B])
Encode A then B; decode B then A
Independent JDK zlib-then-gzip vector tests order and nested trailer restoration.
IR RDF export: ir:encodedWith
One RDF list of codec IRIs, preserving encoder order and repeated codecs
Prerelease representation change: consumers must traverse rdf:first/rdf:rest rather than treating predicate values as an unordered codec set.
Zlib / raw DEFLATE with level
Integer compression level -1 (default) or 0..9. Values are validated before execution.
Controls encoding only; decoding does not need the level and does not certify the original encoder setting. Existing decoded-byte limits remain active.
Other codec options
Not yet supported by the interpreter
Unknown names, unsupported codecs, duplicate names and noninteger or out-of-range values reject. Generated runtimes reject parameterized pipelines until they can preserve the settings.
IR encodingOptions
Optional list of per-stage integer maps, aligned with encodedWith
IR RDF exports parallel ordered option lists. An empty map marks a stage without options; absence means all stages have no options.

name: Constraint reuse
rule: Private authoring fragments expand into the existing shapes before publication. Targets stay on their original shapes; reusable value constraints do not acquire domain-wide activation.
exceptions: Preserve the exact datatype alternatives, RDF list order, count and numeric bounds, messages, severity and result structure. Similar-looking raster and sampling constraints are not interchangeable.
